verdict.rationale: Every finding includes a suggested patch. Developers can click Request fix to open a gecko/* pull request with the patch applied, apply it themselves, or have Gecko commit the fix directly to an existing PR branch. PR reviews also offer one-click fixes, and Gecko rechecks the finding and marks it Fix verified once the fix merges. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated fixes work as described (all evidence is vendor documentation).
